subject: ss-haematology
title: Hodgkin lymphoma Reed Sternberg cells staging and ABVD therapy
refs: Harrison Principles of Internal Medicine 22e Ch 114 Hodgkin Lymphoma

steps.tx: **Hodgkin lymphoma** (HL, malignant Reed Sternberg B cells in reactive background) is rare but highly curable, peaking in young adults and older adults. **Reed Sternberg cells** (RS cells, giant binucleate cells with mirror nuclei) form under **1** percent of tissue cells. **HRS cells** (Hodgkin Reed Sternberg cells) secrete cytokines that recruit T cells, eosinophils and macrophages around them. Incidence is near **3** per **one hundred thousand** yearly.
steps.say: Hodgkin lymphoma spreads through rare malignant cells in a reactive background. RS cells form under one percent of tumour tissue. Cure rates exceed eighty percent in modern practice.

steps.tx: **Epstein Barr virus** (EBV, latent infection) drives about **40** percent of classical HL cases, with higher rates in mixed cellularity and HIV linked disease. **HIV infection** (immune deficiency) raises HL risk **10** fold and EBV rates climb higher still. **Young adult peak** (age **20** to **40**) dominates in developed countries. **Male predominance** is mild overall but stronger in nodular sclerosis in women.
steps.say: EBV is present in about forty percent of classical cases worldwide. HIV raises risk tenfold with higher EBV rates. Young adults dominate in developed countries today.

steps.tx: Two great families split HL biology. **Classical HL** (cHL, RS cell disease) shows **CD30** (tumour marker) and **CD15** (myeloid marker) on HRS cells with weak **PAX5** (B cell factor) and lost **CD20** (B cell marker). **Nodular lymphocyte predominant HL** (NLPHL, LP cell disease) shows LP cells (popcorn cells) with strong **CD20** and **CD79a** (B cell markers) and usually **CD30** negative. **LP cells** (lymphocyte predominant cells) evolve like B cell lymphoma.
steps.say: Classical HL loses CD20 and gains CD15 and CD30 expression. NLPHL keeps CD20 strong and CD30 negative. LP cells are like B cell lymphoma.

steps.tx: Four classical subtypes fill most cases. **Nodular sclerosis** (NS, commonest subtype) strikes young women with mediastinal masses and lacunar cells. **Mixed cellularity** (MC, second commonest) shows classic RS cells with eosinophils and EBV positivity most often. **Lymphocyte rich** (LR, favourable) and **lymphocyte depleted** (LD, aggressive) complete the list. **NS** forms about **seventy** percent of classical cases in young adults.
steps.say: Nodular sclerosis affects young women with mediastinal masses. Mixed cellularity is EBV positive most often. Lymphocyte depleted disease is the most aggressive form in this group.

steps.tx: Patients present with **painless lymphadenopathy** (painless enlarged nodes) in cervical or supraclavicular regions. **B symptoms** (fever above **38** degrees, >10 percent weight loss, drenching night sweats) define adverse prognosis. **Pruritus** (itching) and **pel Ebstein fever** (cyclic fever) are classical associations. **Contiguous spread** (to neighbouring nodes) rules HL, unlike non Hodgkin lymphoma which skips regions. Bone pain marks stage **4** disease.
steps.say: Painless cervical nodes are the usual presentation pattern in HL. B symptoms worsen prognosis in every stage. Contiguous nodal spread is the classic Hodgkin signature.

steps.tx: **Lugano staging** (modern HL staging) uses **PET CT** (scan combining metabolic and anatomical imaging) as the standard tool. Stage **1** covers single region disease, stage **2** covers same side regions, stage **3** covers both sides of diaphragm, and stage **4** covers disseminated organ disease. **Ann Arbor** (older system) survives only as descriptive language. **Bulky disease** (mass above **seven** cm) worsens prognosis and triggers radiation.
steps.say: Lugano staging uses PET CT as the standard examination tool. Stage four means disseminated organ disease today. Bulky mass above seven centimetres worsens prognosis.

steps.tx: **ABVD** (four drug regimen, standard acronym) cures most HL and stays the backbone worldwide. Early favourable disease gets **2** to **4** cycles of ABVD plus **involved field radiation** (targeted radiotherapy). **PET guided therapy** (scan responses decide cycles) cuts chemotherapy where response is complete after **2** cycles. **Brentuximab vedotin** (anti CD30 antibody drug conjugate) replaces bleomycin in advanced disease in many centres.
steps.say: ABVD is the curative regimen in most patients worldwide today. PET responses decide how many cycles continue overall. Brentuximab vedotin targets CD30 in advanced disease.

steps.tx: **Escalated BEACOPP** (intensive acronym regimen) lifts control in advanced HL but costs fertility and second cancers. **GHSG** (Hodgkin Study Group, German trial group) HD9 era trials settled dose intensity debates. **Checkpoint inhibitors** (PD1 blockers like nivolumab) rescue relapsed disease with high response rates. **CAR T cells** (engineered T cells) target **CD30** in refractory cases at trial centres.
steps.say: Escalated BEACOPP improves disease control in advanced HL disease. PD1 blockers rescue relapsed disease effectively today. CD30 directed CAR T cells remain investigational options.

steps.tx: Late toxicity colours survivorship for decades. **Bleomycin lung injury** (fibrosis) demands baseline lung function and lifetime dose caps near **four hundred** units. **Doxorubicin cardiac injury** (cardiomyopathy) needs anthracycline cumulative dose limits and echocardiography. **Second malignancy** (especially breast) rises above **10** percent at **20** years after mantle radiation. **Infertility** (gonadal failure) follows alkylating regimens and pelvic radiation.
steps.say: Bleomycin lung injury and doxorubicin cardiac injury are the main late effects. Second cancers rise above ten percent at twenty years. Mantle radiation is a breast cancer risk.

steps.tx: Exam stems reward the following contrasts. **RS cells** (giant binucleate cells) live in HL, never in non Hodgkin lymphoma. **CD30** (marker) positivity with weak PAX5 points to classical HL over NLPHL. **Contiguous spread** (stepwise nodal spread) is a Hodgkin signature. **Night sweats**, **fever** and weight loss together form **B symptoms** and upstage adverse prognosis in every system.
steps.say: RS cells are seen only in Hodgkin lymphoma in exam stems. Contiguous spread forms the Hodgkin signature pattern. B symptoms always worsen prognosis in every system.

steps.tx: High-yield for the exam: **RS cells** (giant binucleate cells) with **CD30** **CD15** and weak **PAX5** define classical HL. **ABVD** is the curative backbone, and **PET negative** after **2** cycles may allow stopping. **B symptoms** include fever, night sweats and weight loss above **10** percent. **Nodular sclerosis** is the commonest subtype, and **cure rates** exceed **eighty** percent.
steps.say: RS cells with CD30 and CD15 are the classical Hodgkin cells. ABVD forms the curative backbone of therapy. PET negativity after two cycles guides stopping.
